baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated departure across the two seasonal poles becomes familiar attachment: movement is not a one-off trip but a practiced mode of continuity.

baseline_models.mechanism: Distinct stages, quarters, and season-bound actions are joined into one circuit; coherence is an achieved arrangement of heterogeneous parts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed lexical potentials of ٱلشِّتَآءِ and ٱلصَّيْفِ within one composed رِحْلَةَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The circuit joins unequal seasonal conditions: winter can image famine and rough exposure, while summer can image rain and yield. Travel mediates between deficit and replenishment.

changed_reading.before: Winter and summer are neutral calendar labels.
changed_reading.after: The seasonal circuit is a resilience mechanism joining periods of privation and yield so that their asymmetry can be survived.

strongest_changes: The repeated ء ل ف wording turns habituation into a feedback loop in which cohesion enables the circuit and the circuit renews cohesion.
The fixed house polarizes the portable dwelling senses of رِحْلَةَ, producing an anchored rhythm of departure and return.
Feeding-hunger and security-fear recast the winter-summer circuit as provision and safe-passage infrastructure that transforms lack and risk.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms—habit, composition, portable dwelling, seasonal compensation, stewardship, and conversion—while branch-distant cues opened tractable-road, grafted-network, growth, and adaptive-detour readings without displacing the ordinary seasonal journey.
remaining_uncertainties: The direction between secure passage and habituation remains reversible: protection may enable repetition, or repeated survival may produce trust.
The non-dominant ر ب و growth activation is packet-backed but may remain only a lexical shadow beside the dominant stewardship reading.
Winter-famine and summer-rain form a coherent compensatory model, but the focus syntax itself does not assign deficit and yield causally to the two journeys.
The fixed house may organize the travel circuit spatially, or it may function only as the directed center of the following service.
